description: Executes an endpoint found via search_endpoints. Pass `routeId` and `arguments` (keys = `parameters[].name` of that route; omit if the route has none). If payment is required, returns isError=true with `x402Version`+`accepts` in structuredContent - sign those accepts and retry with `_meta["x402/payment"]` (base64 payload). Other isError cases: `invalid_arguments` (structuredContent.details[]/requiredArgs[] tell what to fix and retry), `route_unresolved` (pick another routeId from plan[]), `failed` (refunded/refundTx; try another route). On success, returns the actual result of the endpoint. No auth. Limits: paid 300/5min, burst 200/10s, total 1000/15min per IP.

arguments.description: Endpoint arguments. Keys = `parameters[].name` of the chosen route. Example: `parameters[] = [{name:"address", in:"path", required:true}]` → `{ "address": "0x098B…" }`.

name: call_endpoint
